posts.cooked:

if i give BPTS again then will i be able to improve by score or not

posts.name: S.HARITHAA
posts.cooked: I think they are to be attended for eligibility purpose only

posts.name: Mrinal
posts.cooked:
If you are repeating only OPPE this term, the BPT marks will only be used for checking your eligibility. For grading they will be carried over from the last term.

So, NO! You cannot improve yout BPT scores.
